credit.credit-words: Lord, I Have Shut the Door
WORDS and MUSIC: “Sanctuary”; William M. Runyan, 1923. Public Domain.

When thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret. Mt. 6:6 When he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and... was there alone. Mt. 14:23
